svg.title: P37 populated A01 hybrid proposal
svg.desc: All dimensions mm. Colored package rectangles are source courtyard/pad envelopes, not qualified full solids. Unknown neighbors are not free.

g.text: P37 / populated A01 hybrid — 24 mm ordinary spacer stack
86 package candidates +10 connector positions; 22 retained wire lands/fixed LED substrate omitted from view
Source courtyard views; fixed front controls unchanged. Dashed rings: Ø8 tool reservations, not proved access.
Direct headers: (295,220) signal16; (295,250) power8. Same global XY, opposite-face numbering mirrored.
New M3 spacer sites: (254,180), (300,180), (254,274), (300,274). Old rear carrier removed in proposal.
Core near face74; far face75.6. Exposed18.29 pins; socket8.51; conditional insertion4.55–6.13.
Control lower tab x206.5–230.5,y290–312. Orange outline is a NEW PCB change; neighboring fit still open.
Cable routes / parking and foreign populated volumes remain reservations — see report, not hidden clear space.
Remove cover → support core → undo4 screws → axial7 mm → total40 mm → unplug front IDC for front service.
Unpowered integrated prototype: actual A01 stack + three ribbons + representative neighbor envelopes. No coupon/order.
